# Infourok

> Infourok is Russia's leading educational platform providing comprehensive professional development, teaching resources, and online tutoring services for educators and students.

Infourok (ООО «Инфоурок») operates a vast ecosystem of educational services including a 7M+ material library, professional certification courses, virtual classrooms, and an online tutoring marketplace. The platform serves teachers across Russia with lesson plans, presentations, tests, and distance learning infrastructure aligned with ФГОС standards.

## Key Topics

- Professional development courses
- Teacher certification
- Distance learning
- Educational materials marketplace
- Virtual classroom
- Exam preparation (ОГЭ, ЕГЭ)
- ФГОС curriculum standards
- Online tutoring
- Lesson planning resources
- Professional retraining
- Continuing education
- School subjects (K-12)
- Video lectures
- Teacher training
- Presentations and tests

## Professional Development & Certification

- [Professional Retraining Courses](https://infourok.ru/kursy/coursePP): Professional retraining courses with diplomas and distance learning
- [Teacher Qualification Improvement Courses](https://infourok.ru/kursy/coursePK): Teacher qualification improvement courses with certificates
- [Audio-Based Professional Development](https://infourok.ru/kursy/audioPK): Audio-based professional development and certification courses
- [Mini-Courses](https://infourok.ru/mini-kursy): Short video courses for professional development with certification
- [Professional Certification & Testing](https://infourok.ru/tests): Professional certification and qualification testing platform

## Teaching Resources & Materials

- [Materials Marketplace](https://infourok.ru/magazin-materialov): Marketplace with 681,000+ downloadable lesson plans and materials
- [Teacher Materials Library](https://infourok.ru/biblioteka): Library of 7M+ teacher materials: presentations, plans, tests
- [Educational Materials & Classroom Resources](https://infourok.ru/assistant): Educational materials and classroom resources for teachers
- [Lesson Planning & Work Programs](https://infourok.ru/workProgram): Lesson planning and work program resources for teachers

## Online Learning & Tutoring

- [Online School with Tutor Directory](https://school.infourok.ru): Online tutoring platform with teacher directory for grades 1-11
- [Free Video Lessons](https://school.infourok.ru/video-lessons): Free video lessons for grades 1-11 across all school subjects
- [Virtual Classroom](https://infourok.ru/virtualnyj-klass): Virtual classroom tools for conducting distance learning sessions

## Course Catalog & Events

- [Unified Course Catalog](https://infourok.ru/kursyLanding): Unified catalog of courses, webinars and testing for teachers
- [Events & Webinars](https://infourok.ru/meropriyatiya): Events catalog with webinars and video lectures for teachers

## News & Information

- [News & Articles](https://infourok.ru/news): News and articles on education, pedagogy and distance learning
